notes: The chronogram 'rasa-muni-muni-candra' gives Śaka 1776. The month is specified as 'vārddhyāṣāḍha' (vṛddhy-āṣāḍha, intercalary/adhika Āṣāḍha), which indeed occurred in 1854 CE. The word 'jinajo' modifying Bhuvanānanda is ambiguous (possibly corrupt for 'dvijajo', or 'born of Jina', etc.) and has not been split into a separate person.
